reason: My guests are tourists and the reviews that bring them in are on Google and Tripadvisor, not in a new local app. And if guests pay from a QR code, my waiters will think they lose their tips and fight it from day one.
objection: Nothing says how tips work when the guest pays on their phone, and my staff will sabotage anything that touches the bill. On top of that I'd pay the per-transaction fee again on top of my terminal, for reviews nobody I care about will read.
would_change_my_mind: A built-in tip option that goes straight to the waiter, and paid guests being pushed to leave their review on Google too, not only inside HoReCa Hub.
